business.name: T L Central Heating and Air

factors.name: Independent live website exists
factors.note: Only online presence found is a Bryant.com manufacturer dealer-locator profile page. No independently-owned or operated website exists. Per methodology, category score is 0 when no site exists rather than averaged against inapplicable sub-factors.

factors.name: GBP found and reasonably complete
factors.note: No Google Business Profile or Maps listing surfaced across two independent targeted searches (business name + 'google maps listing', and the street address). Absence is the finding, scored as 0 per methodology, not excluded — but labeled Likely rather than Verified since the Google Maps UI itself was not checked directly.

factors.name: NAP consistency across listings found
factors.note: Excluded from denominator — only one source (the Bryant dealer page) was found, so there is nothing to cross-check consistency against.

factors.name: Appears in results for the primary local query tested
factors.note: Surfaces for 'AC repair Celina TX' and 'HVAC Celina TX' searches, but only via the Bryant manufacturer dealer page, not via an owned listing or Maps pack presence — weaker than true local-pack visibility, so awarded partial credit.

factors.name: Any reviews found, any platform
factors.note: Two independent search passes (general + review-specific, including Yelp/BBB) returned zero reviews under this business name. Absence is the finding; category score is 0.

factors.name: Business identity stated clearly and consistently somewhere crawlable
factors.note: Name, address, phone, and service list are stated clearly on the Bryant dealer page (confirmed by direct fetch).

factors.name: Structured data / consistent NAP an AI system could read
factors.note: No schema or owned structured data exists (no owned site). The one source that exists is internally coherent, but that is a low bar, not confirmed cross-source consistency.

factors.name: Content directly answering likely customer questions
factors.note: The dealer page lists service categories but answers none of the questions a customer or AI assistant would actually ask (hours, service area, emergency availability, financing).

factors.name: No contradictory facts across sources checked
factors.note: Nothing contradicts the one source found, but that is because only one source exists to check against, not because consistency was confirmed across multiple independent sources. Scored as weak partial credit, not full marks.

technical_findings.finding: No independently-owned or operated website found. The business's only online presence is a Bryant.com manufacturer dealer-locator profile page.
technical_findings.evidence: https://www.bryant.com/en/us/dealers/tx/celina/803-w-cedar-st-bry-6753-loc lists the business name, address, phone, and a Bryant-branded service list; no link to an independent site.
technical_findings.source: Direct fetch of the Bryant dealer page

local_findings.finding: No discoverable Google Business Profile or Maps listing surfaced in public search under this business name or address.
local_findings.evidence: Searches for '"T L Central Heating and Air" google maps listing' and '"803 W Cedar St" Celina TX' returned no GBP/Maps result.

local_findings.finding: The business appears in generic local-intent search results (e.g. 'AC repair Celina TX') only via the Bryant manufacturer dealer page, not through its own search visibility.
local_findings.evidence: Search results for 'AC repair Celina TX' and 'HVAC heating and air Celina TX reviews' surfaced the Bryant dealer page but no owned listing.

aeo_findings.finding: Name, address, phone, and services are stated clearly and consistently on the one page that represents this business online.
aeo_findings.evidence: Bryant dealer page fetch — see technical_findings.

aeo_findings.finding: There is no owned content answering common customer questions (hours, service area, emergency availability, financing) anywhere crawlable. An AI assistant asked about this business has only a bare-bones manufacturer listing to draw from.
aeo_findings.evidence: Same Bryant dealer page; no other source found.

review_findings.finding: No customer reviews found on Google, Yelp, BBB, or any other platform across two independent search passes.
review_findings.evidence: Searches '"T L Central Heating" Celina reviews OR rating OR yelp OR BBB' and general Celina HVAC review searches returned no results under this business name.

search_observations.observed: T L Central Heating and Air appears only via its Bryant.com dealer page. AIR RESCUE Heating and Cooling, One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning of Aubrey and Celina, and Xtreme Air Services surfaced with their own websites and review counts.

search_observations.query: HVAC heating and air Celina TX reviews
search_observations.observed: AIR RESCUE Heating and Cooling (4.9/412) and KMI A/C & Heating (4.9/73) surfaced as the leading reviewed businesses. T L Central did not appear in this review-focused query at all.

methodology_notes: No Google Search Console, GBP Insights, or live Maps-ranking access for this business — all findings are from public web search and one direct page fetch, consistent with the environment limitation already documented in PRINCETON-AUTO-SHOPS-AUDIT.md for similarly website-less businesses. GBP absence and review absence are based on search-engine results, not a direct check of the Google Maps UI; both are labeled Likely rather than Verified for that reason.
